👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, yeh kahani shuru hoti hai 1942 se. Us waqt India mein British Raj tha. Puri duniya World War II mein jal rahi thi, aur Adolf Hitler United Kingdom ki taraf itni tezi se badh raha tha ki British Raj ki haalat kharab ho gayi. Hitler ne sirf 10 mahino mein Poland, Denmark, Norway, Netherlands, Belgium aur France par kabza kar liya.
Toh British government ne apni shipping capacity badhane ke liye India mein paints ke import par ban laga diya. Tabhi Shalimar Paints India ka sabse bada player tha, jiske paas bade-bade contracts the.
Jab market par Shalimar Paints jaise giants ka control tha  toh Asian Paints ne unhe beat kaise kiya? Kaunse 3 strategic pillars ne Asian Paints ko 59 saalon tak market leader banaye rakha?
